description: Downloads all relevant wiki pages for your project as a single plain-text bundle (no ZIP decode needed). The returned bundle IS your working set: every listed page is included in full, so do NOT call read_page on any of them afterwards. Work locally in this conversation, then push back with push_session_bundle when done. Measured 10.04s of individual read_page calls versus 3.47s for the same ten pages bundled. For a project, prefer folder=projects/<slug> over tags — folder membership is structural and cannot drift, whereas tags are hand-maintained and frequently incomplete (measured on a real wiki: tags returned 0 of 39 pages for one project and 2 of 49 for another, while the folder selector returned all of them). Use tags only for cross-cutting themes that span folders. If you do not know the project slug, do NOT guess one: list_pages with folder='projects' shows the available projects — resolve the slug first, then pull. Always set maxBytes=150000 to stay within context limits. Paginates via nextCursor. Each entry in the returned 'pages' array includes a 'revision' — pass it back on the matching page in push_session_bundle's pages mode to get conflict protection against other concurrent writers (e.g. a shared project).
name: pull_session_bundle
